hook.name: PRNTRHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for WETH-paired token pools that collects custom protocol fees on buys (via BeforeSwapDelta in beforeSwap) and sells (via AfterSwapDelta in afterSwap). Applies an elevated 85% sniper fee during the first 30 seconds after pool launch; otherwise charges a fixed fee tier (1–5%). Fees accumulate in the hook and are claimable by a designated factory contract.
